The CMA (cma‑01) explicitly lists the adjustment constants ($110 / sq ft, $12,000 per bedroom, $15,000 per bathroom, $14,000 per condition‑score point) and the filters (3 mi distance, 180 day age) that were chosen by the analyst, not derived from empirical data. These rates are therefore assumptions, not validated coefficients, and may double‑count value (e.g., bedroom size and square‑footage) or miss unmodeled factors such as lot size, school districts, or concessions. [cma-01]

The eight comparable property records (property‑02 – property‑08) provide the adjusted prices, weights, and distances but lack verified condition scores, concession amounts, and property‑type identification. Because condition scores are unverified and concessions are absent, the $14,000 per condition‑score adjustment is based on subjective data, and any unobserved condition effects remain unmodeled. [property-02] [property-03] [property-04] [property-05] [property-06] [property-07] [property-08]

No empirical trend or probability model is included; the 0 % monthly trend and the weighted‑mean price ($727,321) are scenario anchors, not forecasts. The range $719,400–$738,100 reflects adjusted observed comparables, not a statistical confidence interval, so reliance on these numbers for pricing decisions requires professional validation. [cma-01]
